mapper.sql: WITH book AS ( WITH book1 AS ( SELECT '1' seq , ast09_book.* FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, ast09_hold_date) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, MAX(ast09_hold_date) FROM ast09_book WHERE ast09_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast09_hold_date <= #{holdDate} GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) UNION ALL SELECT '2' seq , ast11_book_id , ast11_hold_date , ast11_ast_class_tree_id , ast11_keep_account_id , ast11_hold_qty , ast11_pur_amt , ast11_book_amt , ast11_eval_amt , ast11_eval_pl , ast11_first_pur_amt , ast11_first_pur_date , ast11_company_id , ast11_for_pur_amt , ast11_for_book_amt , ast11_for_eval_amt , ast11_for_eval_pl , ast11_fx_pl , ast11_book_end_yn , ast11_acr_int_amt , ast11_for_acr_int_amt , ast11_oci , ast11_for_oci , ast11_lock_up_period_cd , ast11_lock_up_date , ast11_lock_up_qty FROM ast11_book_close WHERE ast11_company_id = #{companyId} AND (ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id, ast11_hold_date) IN ( SELECT ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id, MAX(ast11_hold_date) FROM ast11_book_close WHERE ast11_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast11_hold_date < #{holdDate} GROUP BY ast11_ast_class_tree_id, ast11_keep_account_id ) ) SELECT * FROM book1 WHERE (ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, to_char(ast09_hold_date,'yyyymmdd')||seq) IN ( SELECT ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id, MAX(to_char(ast09_hold_date,'yyyymmdd')||seq) FROM book1 GROUP BY ast09_ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id ) )
mapper.select: SELECT ast40_std_date AS std_date, ast40_amt AS amt FROM ast40_owner_capital INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = ast40_company_id WHERE ast40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast40_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast40_std_date) FROM ast40_owner_capital WHERE ast40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast40_std_date <= ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys01_owner_capital_apply_cd,'10') = '20' /*(20:전전월말)*/ THEN f_get_last_day((CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) + interval '-2month')::date) ELSE CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) END ) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT row_number()over() AS book_id , f_cdnm('InvestAssetType', ast41_invest_asset_type, #{companyId}, CAST(#{holdDate} AS date)) AS invest_asset_type_name , MAX(ast41_limit_rate) AS limit_rate , MAX(TRUNC(owner_capital * ast41_limit_rate / 100)) AS limit_amt , SUM(COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0)) AS eval_amt , SUM(ast09_pur_amt) AS pur_amt , TRUNC(SUM(COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0)) * 100 / MAX(owner_capital),2) AS capital_ratio , MAX(owner_capital) AS owner_capital , MAX(owner_capital_std_ym) AS owner_capital_std_ym FROM book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_limit_rate FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast41_start_date) FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date <= CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) ) ) ast41 ON ast01_item_s_class_cd LIKE ast41_invest_asset_type INNER JOIN ( SELECT ast40_amt AS owner_capital , to_char(ast40_std_date,'yyyy.mm') AS owner_capital_std_ym FROM ast40_owner_capital INNER JOIN sys01_company ON ast40_company_id = sys01_company_id WHERE ast40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast40_std_date = ( SELECT MAX(ast40_std_date) FROM ast40_owner_capital WHERE ast40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast40_std_date <= ( CASE WHEN COALESCE(sys01_owner_capital_apply_cd,'10') = '20' /*(20:전전월말)*/ THEN f_get_last_day((CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) + interval '-2month')::date) ELSE CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) END ) ) ) ast40 ON 1=1 WHERE COALESCE(ast09_book_end_yn,'false') != 'true' AND ast01_asset_type = '1' /* 1:고유자산 / 2:운용(펀드)자산 */ GROUP BY ast41_invest_asset_type ORDER BY ast41_invest_asset_type

SELECT ast09_book_id AS book_id, ast09_hold_date AS hold_date, ast09_ast_class_tree_id AS ast_class_tree_id, ast09_keep_account_id AS keep_account_id , ast09_keep_account_nm AS keep_account_name, ast09_ast_class_nm AS ast_class_name, ast09_ast_class_tree_nm AS ast_class_tree_name , ast09_first_pur_date AS first_pur_date, ast09_hold_qty AS hold_qty, ast09_pur_amt AS pur_amt, ast09_book_amt AS book_amt , ast09_pur_price AS pur_price, ast09_eval_price AS eval_price, ast09_eval_amt AS eval_amt, ast09_eval_pl AS eval_pl , ast09_pur_eval_pl AS pur_eval_pl, ast09_ty_pl_rate AS ty_pl_rate, ast09_pur_pl_rate AS pur_pl_rate , ast09_stop_loss_notice AS stop_loss_notice, ast09_sell_possible_date AS sell_possible_date, ast09_hold_period AS hold_period FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN ast09_book_end_yn = 'true' THEN ast09_hold_date ELSE CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) END as ast09_std_date , ast1.ast01_class_tree_nm as ast09_ast_class_tree_nm , COALESCE(ast1.ast01_tr_unit,1) as ast09_ast_tr_unit , ast2.ast01_corp_id as ast09_corp_id , f_get_corp_nm(ast2.ast01_corp_id) as ast09_corp_nm , ast2.ast01_class_tree_nm as ast09_keep_account_nm , ast2.ast01_seq as ast09_keep_account_seq , f_get_corp_nm(ast2.ast01_corp_id) ||'('||f_ast_class_tree_nm(ast09_keep_account_id)||')' as ast09_keep_corp_account_nm , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) ||CASE WHEN substr(ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,5) = '99' THEN '' ELSE '('||f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date)||')' END as ast09_ast_class_nm , ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd as ast09_ast_m_class_cd , ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd as ast09_ast_s_class_cd , ast1.ast01_account_type as ast09_account_type , f_cdnm('ItemMClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_m_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) as ast09_ast_m_class_nm , f_cdnm('ItemSClassCode',ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) as ast09_ast_s_class_nm , f_cdnm('AccountType' ,ast1.ast01_account_type ,ast09_company_id,ast09_hold_date) as ast09_account_type_nm , COALESCE(ast1.ast01_cur_cd,'KRW') as ast09_cur_code , f_cdnm('LockUpPeriodCode', ast09_lock_up_period_cd, ast09_company_id, ast09_hold_date) as ast09_lock_up_period_nm , f_get_sellPossibleQty(ast09_book_id, CAST(#{holdDate} AS date)) as ast09_sell_possible_qty , COALESCE(ast09_lock_up_qty,0) as ast09_lock_up_qty , CASE WHEN ast09_lock_up_date IS NULL THEN ast09_first_pur_date ELSE f_get_biz_date2(0, ast09_lock_up_date, '+1', 'true') END as ast09_sell_possible_date , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN null ELSE trunc(ast09_eval_amt / f_nvl(ast09_hold_qty,1) * COALESCE(ast1.ast01_tr_unit,1),2) END as ast09_eval_price , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_pur_amt,0) = 0 THEN null ELSE trunc(ast09_pur_amt / f_nvl(ast09_hold_qty,1) * COALESCE(ast1.ast01_tr_unit,1),2) END as ast09_pur_price , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE trunc((ast09_eval_amt - ast09_book_amt) / f_nvl(ast09_book_amt,1) * 100,2) END as ast09_ty_pl_rate , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE trunc((ast09_eval_amt - ast09_pur_amt ) / f_nvl(ast09_pur_amt ,1) * 100,2) END as ast09_pur_pl_rate , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ast09_eval_amt - ast09_pur_amt END as ast09_pur_eval_pl , CASE WHEN ast09_book_end_yn = 'true' THEN '미보유' ELSE (CASE WHEN ast09_lock_up_date IS NOT NULL THEN f_get_datediff(f_get_biz_date2(0, ast09_lock_up_date, '+1', 'true'), CAST(#{holdDate} AS date), '2') ELSE f_get_datediff(ast09_first_pur_date, CAST(#{holdDate} AS date), '2') END) END as ast09_hold_period , CASE WHEN ast41_stop_loss_rate IS NULL THEN '정보없음' WHEN COALESCE(ast09_eval_amt,0) = 0 THEN '미평가' ELSE (CASE WHEN (ast09_eval_amt - ast09_pur_amt) / f_nvl(ast09_pur_amt,1) * 100 <= (ast41_stop_loss_rate * -1) THEN '매도필요' ELSE '' END) END as ast09_stop_loss_notice , book.* FROM book INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast1 ON ast1.ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_ast_class_tree_id INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree ast2 ON ast2.ast01_class_tree_id = ast09_keep_account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ast41_invest_asset_type, ast41_stop_loss_rate FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date IN ( SELECT MAX(ast41_start_date) FROM ast41_invest_limit WHERE ast41_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast41_start_date <= CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) ) ) ast41 ON ast1.ast01_item_s_class_cd LIKE ast41_invest_asset_type WHERE ast1.ast01_asset_type = '1' /* 1:고유자산 / 2:운용(펀드)자산 */ AND ast1.ast01_item_l_class_cd = '20' /* 20:증권 */ ) t
WHERE concat(ast09_keep_account_nm,ast09_ast_class_nm,ast09_ast_class_tree_nm) LIKE upper(#{searchText}) AND ast09_ast_s_class_cd LIKE #{investAssetType}
AND ( ( '1' = #{periodType} AND ast09_std_date >= CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) + interval '-1month' ) OR ( '2' = #{periodType} AND ast09_std_date >= CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) + interval '-3month' ) OR ( '3' = #{periodType} AND ast09_std_date >= CAST(#{holdDate} AS date) + interval '-1year' ) OR ( '4' = #{periodType} AND ast09_std_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} ) )
AND ast09_book_end_yn != 'true'
ORDER BY ast09_keep_account_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc, ast09_ast_s_class_cd, ast09_ast_class_tree_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc

SELECT t.ast06_tr_id AS tr_id , t.ast06_date AS date , t.ast08_qty AS qty , trunc(t.ast08_price,2) AS price , t.ast08_tr_amt AS tr_amt , t.ast06_amt AS amt , CASE WHEN t.ast06_tr_cd = '3150' AND '1' = #{trType} THEN '대체입고' WHEN t.ast06_tr_cd = '3150' AND '2' = #{trType} THEN '대체출고' ELSE f_cdnm('trCode', t.ast06_tr_cd, t.ast06_company_id, t.ast06_date) END AS note , COALESCE(t.ast08_fee, 0) + COALESCE(t.ast08_tr_tax, 0) AS fee_sum , t.ast08_pur_amt AS pur_book_amt , trunc((t.ast06_amt - COALESCE(t.ast08_pur_amt ,0)) / f_nvl(t.ast08_pur_amt ,1) * 100,2) AS pur_pl_rate , t.ast06_amt - COALESCE(t.ast08_pur_amt ,0) AS pl FROM ( SELECT * , CASE WHEN '1' = #{trType} THEN 0 ELSE ast08_tr_amt - (COALESCE(ast08_int_amt,0) + COALESCE(ast08_acr_int_amt,0)) END AS pl_calc_std_amt FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN ast08_tr_finance ON ast08_tr_id = ast06_tr_id WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} AND ast08_account_id = #{keepAccountId} AND ( ( '1' = #{trType} AND /*(1:매수)*/ ast06_tr_cd IN ('3101','3103','3302','3500','3503','3104' ) ) OR ( '2' = #{trType} AND /*(2:매도)*/ ast06_tr_cd IN ('3201','3202','3203','3210','3301','3204','3209') ) ) UNION ALL SELECT * , 0 AS pl_calc_std_amt FROM ast06_tr INNER JOIN ast08_tr_finance ON ast08_tr_id = ast06_tr_id WHERE ast06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ast06_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} AND ast06_tr_cd = '3150' /*(3150:계좌대체)*/ AND ( ( '1' = #{trType} AND /*(1:매수)*/ ast08_in_account_id = #{keepAccountId} ) OR ( '2' = #{trType} AND /*(2:매도)*/ ast08_account_id = #{keepAccountId} ) ) ) t WHERE t.ast06_date <= CAST(#{stdDate} AS date) ORDER BY t.ast06_date, t.ast06_tr_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_double01, sys99_double02 , sys99_long01, sys99_long02, sys99_long03, sys99_long04 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , #{b.ownerCapitalStdYm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b.investAssetTypeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{b.limitRate,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), #{b.capitalRatio,jdbcType=NUMERIC} , #{b.ownerCapital,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, COALESCE(#{b.limitAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), #{b.evalAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{b.purAmt,jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
